newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P rates Telecom capital notes AA-.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Telecom capital notes AA-.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard and Poor's said it had assigned its AA- rating to NZ$275 million Telecom Corp of New Zealand capital notes, issued by Telecom subsidiary TCNZ Finance Ltd earlier on Monday.
TCNZ Finance senior debt was rated AA by S&P.

S&P repeated that in had decided in February to downgrade Telecom's corporate rating to AA from AA+ in the aftermath of the company's move to externally finance a $!.0 billion share repurchase programme.
Overall, however, it believed Telecom's outlook is stable.

"(It) has proven to be a strong competitor in one of the world's most deregulated telecommunications markets. Its strong and diverse revenue base provides a fundamental strength to the ratings, and this is not expected to change in the medium term," it added.
